$description: Eric Escapes brand tokens. W3C DTCG flavoured. Same data as ericescapes-brand.css. Two palettes: archive (fixed-canvas print artwork) and site (ericescapes.com UI shell). They are not interchangeable.

archive.$description: ARCHIVE PRINT palette. Product covers, envelope mounts, exported artwork on the 1400x2100 canvas. Source of truth is archive-cover-design.md.

ink.$description: Letterpressed look name on the mat

green.$description: Bound by the green law. At most two roles per surface. On a cover those roles are fixed: payline rule and payload text.

hairline-top.$description: Lit top edge of the envelope panel

window-edge.$description: Photo window border, sits on the pale mat so it is black not white

mat.$description: Mat lift off the envelope panel

site.$description: SITE UI palette. Mirrors src/app/globals.css exactly. CSS custom property names are --ee-{name} and must not be renamed.

live.$description: Live indicator only, the pulsing dot

typography.$description: Two families, two jobs. Nothing else is ever introduced.

display.$description: Titles only, uppercase, tight tracking. 700 on covers, 400/500/600 on the site shell. Self-hosted woff2 on the site. Titles are left aligned, never centred.

mono.$description: Everything that is not a title: labels, file and catalogue numbers, captions, conservation stamps, footers. Uppercase, wide tracking, 400/500 only. The machine voice against the human photograph.

wide.$description: Payload line, the widest we go

rules.$description: Non-negotiable usage law. Read these before shipping any surface.

green-law.$value: Green appears in at most two roles per surface, never a third. On an archive cover the two roles are fixed: the payline rule and the payload text. Photography must be the only saturated, living element.

no-photo-over-text.$value: No photo over text, ever. Captions live on the mat, never on the image.

no-ornament.$value: No 3D boxes, spines, rotation on mounts, icons, emoji or rounded accent cards.

em-dash-ban.$value: No em dashes in published copy. Use colons, commas, semicolons or separate sentences.

catalogue-numbering.$value: Tab is FILE / EE-nn. Header right is CAT. EE-{PRODUCT INITIALS}-nn. Footer right is ARCHIVE ENVELOPE / EE-nn.
